phyag chen brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen mkhyen no/ /tai lo shes rab bzang po mkhyen no/ /nā ro dzñā na siddhi

tei:div.tei:p: phyag chen brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen mkhyen no// tai lo shes rab bzang po mkhyen no// nā ro dzñā na siddhi mkhyen no// mar pa chos kyi blo gros mkhyen no// mi la bzhad pa rdo rje mkhyen no// dwags po zla 'od gzhon nu mkhyen no// dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa mkhyen no// si tu 'gro mgon ras chen mkhyen no// spom brag bsod nams rdo rje mkhyen no// grub chen karma pakshi mkhyen no// mkhas grub o rgyan chen po mkhyen no// sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje mkhyen no// rgyal ba g.yung ston chen po mkhyen no// 'dzam gling chos kyi grags pa mkhyen no// rtogs ldan mkha' spyod dbang po mkhyen no// chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen no// rje btsun ratna bha dra mkhyen no// sprul sku mthong ba don ldan mkhyen no// kun mkhyen 'jam dpal bzang po mkhyen no// byang sems dpal 'byor don grub mkhyen no// rgyal dbang chos grags rgya mtsho mkhyen no// grub chen bkra shis dpal 'byor mkhyen no// mtshungs med mi bskyod rdo rje mkhyen no// rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag mkhyen no// rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rje mkhyen no// gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug mkhyen no// rgyal mchog chos dbyings rdo rje mkhyen no// dpal ldan ye shes snying po mkhyen no// mtshungs med ye shes rdo rje mkhyen no// dpal chen chos kyi don grub mkhyen no// rgyal dbang byang chub rdo rje mkhyen no// si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas mkhyen no// rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje mkhyen no// mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho mkhyen no// padma nyin byed dbang po mkhyen no// theg pa mchog gi rdo rje mkhyen no// rgyal sras blo gros mtha' yas mkhyen no// kun bzang mkha' khyab rdo rje mkhyen no// padma dbang mchog rgyal po mkhyen no// dpal ldan mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer mkhyen no// rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje mkhyen no// grub dbang nor bu don grub mkhyen no// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhyen no// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mkhyen no// chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral mkhyen no// bdag sogs 'gro drug sems can kun la// thugs brtse ye shes chen pos gzigs nas// phyag chen gnas lugs rtogs par mdzod cig/
